in_marathi.name: Harleena
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Mountain of happiness
in_marathi.long_meaning: Harleena हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Har = Mountain, Leena = Happiness, This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Harini' meaning 'Mountain of happiness'. Harleena is a beautiful name that embodies joy and contentment.

in_bengali.long_meaning: Harleena একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Har = Mountain, Leena = Happiness, This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Harini' meaning 'Mountain of happiness'. Harleena is a beautiful name that embodies joy and contentment.
